concepts.ganga-in-jata: The Gaṅgā in Śiva's matted hair

annotations.v1-a1: The hymn opens with an old name. *Paśu* first meant an animal on a tether, and *pati* its
annotations.v1-a2: *Ekam* means one, and it can be heard two ways. Taken with Mahādeva, it says He is the One
annotations.v1-a3: Listen to the last two words: *smarāmi smarārim*. *Smarāmi* is "I remember", from *smṛ*. *
